title: Singular Sound Aeros Loop Studio

controlChangeCommands.name: Bank MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Song select MSB; Aeros uses CC0 plus PC, not CC32 LSB

controlChangeCommands.name: Master Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Track 1 Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Track 2 Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Track 3 Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Track 4 Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Track 5 Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Track 6 Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Selected Fader
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Currently selected track fader; 0 = -inf dBFS, 113 = 0 dBFS, 127 = +6 dBFS

controlChangeCommands.name: Loop Decay
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Controls loop decay rate; Loop Decay must be enabled in the song settings

controlChangeCommands.name: Save
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Value 0 saves the currently open song when stopped if changes were made

controlChangeCommands.name: Navigate
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Navigates to Aeros screens

controlChangeCommands.name: List Control
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Controls Songs List navigation; delete confirmation still requires physical Aeros buttons

controlChangeCommands.name: Undo/Redo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 affects selected track top layer; values 1-6 affect track number top layer

controlChangeCommands.name: Mute
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 mutes all; 1-6 toggle tracks; 11-16 mute tracks; 21-26 unmute tracks; 31-36 mute at EOL; 41-46 unmute at EOL; 51-56 mute at EOM; 61-66 unmute at EOM; 71-76 mute immediately; 81-86 unmute immediately; 100 mutes selected track; 110 mute pause; 127 unmute all

controlChangeCommands.name: Solo/Stop
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1-6 solo track number; 127 unsolos and unmutes all other tracks; 0 stops all playback immediately

controlChangeCommands.name: Record Part
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Value 0 begins or sets up a recording in the next empty part

controlChangeCommands.name: R/P/O
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Record/play/overdub and selected track controls

controlChangeCommands.name: Clear Song
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Value 0 clears the song with no confirmation when stopped in Loop Studio; cannot be undone

controlChangeCommands.name: Start/Stop
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Transport and song navigation controls

controlChangeCommands.name: Song Settings
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Sets RPO/ROP behavior and toggles song settings

controlChangeCommands.name: Reverse
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 reverses selected track; values 1-6 reverse track number

controlChangeCommands.name: Lock/Unlock
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Locks or unlocks the selected track, toggling current state

controlChangeCommands.name: Tempo Up
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Increases tempo by value received

controlChangeCommands.name: Tempo Down
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Decreases tempo by value received

controlChangeCommands.name: BB Transition
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: BeatBuddy transition immediately; values 0-32 change song parts, respecting sync/quantize rules when recording

controlChangeCommands.name: Transition
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 starts transition to selected part; 1-6 change part with BeatBuddy flow; 71-76 switch immediately; 81-86 switch at EOM; 91-96 switch at EOL; 101-106 Aeros-only part change; 125 cancel; 126 previous; 127 next

controlChangeCommands.name: Tap Tempo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Enters Tap Tempo mode and generates a tap event

controlChangeCommands.name: Screenshot
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Value 127 saves a screenshot of the current Aeros screen to SD card

x_pc.additionalInfo: Aeros opens songs using CC0 MSB plus PC, in that order. LSB CC32 is not relevant for Aeros song select. The song must first be opened manually and saved with MIDI Song Select enabled to assign the MSB/PC combination.

additionalInfo: Aeros receives MIDI clock, start, stop, BeatBuddy time signature SysEx, and BeatBuddy CC103 time signature values. Aeros can transmit MIDI start/stop, CC41 RPO/ROP state, CC43 cancel stop, CC115 BeatBuddy outro, CC113 transition values, and CC103 time signature values when configured.
